name: My Content Export
subtitle: Your own posts or replies, as a spreadsheet.
summary: Exports your own posts or the replies you've sent as a downloadable spreadsheet. Raw rows for you to slice yourself, with none of the analysis My Replies Report does. Small exports finish immediately.
howToAsk: Download my posts from the last month.
provide: posts or replies; optionally a time window.
get: a downloadable dataset of your own content.
launchPrompt: Export my posts from the last 30 days as a download I can open in a spreadsheet.
